summary: Focus video length on maintaining a duration where averageViewDuration exceeds 35 seconds to maximize retention. Use short, high-impact hooks under 10 words that make visceral or predatory claims, like 'eating you back'. Avoid explanatory or conversational opening statements that lower curiosity. Match engaging visual titles with concise hooks to drive view percentages above 100%. Prioritize biological or physical oddities over historical or manufacturing processes.
winning_hooks: Fresh pineapple is literally eating you back.
This shark is older than the United States.
Your eyes are leaking right now, and your brain is hiding it.
avoid: Starting hooks with explanatory phrases like 'Garlic usually doesn't make you cry because...'
Using process-based topics like 'How Authentic Maple Syrup Is Boiled Down'
Long, multi-clause hook setups that delay the core oddity past the first 3 seconds
next_experiment: Test a physical-reaction topic ('Why your skin gets goosebumps') using a brutal, 6-word hook ('Your body is glitching when you're cold') against a standard explanatory hook.
